(c) Parsing and Execution. This module serves as a safety gate that enforces structural and capacity constraints when applying 𝒪 t \mathcal{O}_{t} : it validates that each path targets a permissible leaf, ensures each value is a string or an allowed deletion marker to avoid parsing ambiguity and state pollution, and applies length control by compressing any overlong value to satisfy the per-leaf budget. Importantly, it performs no conflict resolution or secondary semantic rewriting; it only executes the prescribed operations under these constraints. (d) Versioned Persistence.
